theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl k → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (h : Eucl P → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn h A (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn (fun w => h (Φ w) * Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det) (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A) (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) ∧ ∫ x in A, h x ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ w in Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A, h (Φ w) * Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))
